record.question: The saying 'Lungpui pawh lungte in a kamki loh chuan a awm theilo' implies that:
options: The great rely on the support of the humble
Powerful people matter more than weak people
record.explanation: Official final key: B — The great rely on the support of the humble. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 2, printed Q48. Source limitation: The proverb compares a large stone supported by small stones and appears to express dependence of the great on the humble. A Mizo-language dictionary/anthology or competent language adjudication is still needed to certify its contextual meaning. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
